name: crossover-cable
title: Crossover: Cable
primer: This is an exercise for chest and shoulder strengthening.
steps: Attach the cable pulley to shoulder height.
Grasp a pulley in each hand and stand approximately one foot in front of the weight stacks, with one foot slightly in front of the other.
With a slight bend in your elbows bring your hands together in front of your chest at a downward angle.
When your hands meet at the midpoint of your chest, hold for a moment.
With a slow controlled motion return to the starting position.
